title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Seventy-Five thousand Pesos for Additional Public Land Inspectors to Expedite the Inspection Work of the Bureau of Lands, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury, not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of seventy-five thousand pesos for the salaries and traveling expenses of the following
additional personnel for the Bureau of Lands:
30 public land inspectors at P1,200
50 assistant public land inspectors at P600
Traveling expenses and per diems
9,000.00
---------------
75,000.00

This Act shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and thirty.
Approved, December 2, 1929.
